rules.positive_fixture: tests/engine/test_dispatch.py passes (40 tests): idempotent submit, single-winner threaded claim, expired-lease redispatch with budget, fenced stale operations, recovery sweep with budget, owned cancel, retry exhaustion, create-only explicit ids, canonical id validation; plus CP-03 A06: expired-claim reclaim and recovery sweep each consume one retry with attempts persisted separately, retries_exhausted_by_expiry exhaustion, four-cycle bound; plus DP-01 C01: unknown request fields refused, malformed bounds/pins/conflicting max_rows refused, canonical request identity persisted (pinned and unpinned shapes).
rules.required_proof: tests/engine/test_dispatch.py passes without xfail (44 tests incl. A06 expiry-budget tests, DP-01 C01 request validation/identity tests, and DP-02 C03 keyed-retry binding tests: identical keyed retry returns the same item unchanged, changed-request key reuse refuses, identity-only equivalence, foreign unkeyed duplicate refuses); full pytest green; force_pass exit 0.
rules.requirement: Durable local dispatch: idempotent submit (same key returns the first item; cross-authority key reuse denied), create-only explicit ids (same authority and request returns the immutable record unchanged; changed request or foreign authority refused; history and fencing never reset), canonical id validation with path containment at every entry point, single-winner claim with lease expiry, monotonic fencing tokens refusing every stale lease-holder operation, expired-lease recovery to the queue consuming the retry budget (both reclaim and sweep; attempts persisted separately; retries_exhausted_by_expiry on exhaustion), owning-authority-only cancellation that fences off in-flight workers, and bounded retries resting exhausted. Submit validates the declared request (supported fields only, 64-hex digest pins, positive-integer bounds, no conflicting row bounds) and persists the bound request identity (profile, pinned source-content digest, pinned normalised spec digest). Local durable store only; no platform code imported.
rules.violation_fixture: Overwriting another authority's explicit id, resetting fencing on resubmission, a second claimant on a live lease, a stale token completing after cancel, a foreign-authority cancel or submit, a traversal id writing outside the store, a failure past max_retries being reclaimed, or an unknown request field or malformed bound/pin accepted at submit.

rules.positive_fixture: tests/engine/test_publication.py passes (27 tests) plus the executed submit->publish->download example whose downloaded zip hash equals the reviewed release.sha256, plus tests/engine/test_consumer.py incl. stale-manifest hash/size and non-pass verdict refusals; plus CP-03 A05: invalid download preserves existing good destination byte-identical, interrupted commit preserves destination, same source/destination verifies in place; plus DP-01 C01: wrong-source, tighter-row-bound, and changed-source requests refused with nothing shipped; plus DP-01 C02: post-acceptance ZIP swaps (corrupt and well-formed) refused with the item never marked complete.
rules.required_proof: tests/engine/test_publication.py (27 tests) and tests/engine/test_consumer.py pass without xfail (incl. A05 atomic-download tests and DP-01 C01+C02 binding/snapshot tests); executed example hashes recorded in docs/dispatch-publication-rp09.md; full pytest green; force_pass exit 0.
rules.requirement: Separate publication of accepted releases: publish resolves the run's persisted acceptance record (detached release.sha256 matching the shipped bytes, human accept decision binding the frozen digest, frozen manifest matching that digest, release manifest matching the frozen evidence member for member, shipped report verdict pass covering every persisted required check exactly once, single selected attempt receipt passing and binding the artifact) and ships only a succeeded item's reviewed bytes under the owning authority, with reported digests equal to the persisted ones and a requested profile equal to the run's own. Worker claims never authorise shipment. The dispatch request's bound identity (profile, pinned source-content digest, pinned normalised spec digest) must equal the acceptance-bound identity and the delivered run identity -- profile-name equality alone never suffices -- and a declared row bound must cover the run's executed bound. Verify and copy operate on one captured immutable byte snapshot: the run file is never re-read for shippable bytes, a post-acceptance change refuses at the stability guard, and the snapshot, destination, and persisted accepted digests must agree before the complete mark. Publication ships atomically with in_progress/complete records; interruption resumes to identical bytes; re-publish is a no-op; foreign destination bytes and second releases for one item are refused; download verifies the new bytes in a temporary sibling and commits atomically (verified overwrites, unverified never touches an existing destination, same path verifies in place); consumer verification checks recorded member hashes/sizes, requires a pass verdict, and refuses undecodable bytes as ReleaseVerificationError.
rules.violation_fixture: Publishing an altered report against a stale manifest, a worker claim with a foreign digest shipping different bytes, a missing or mismatched release.sha256, an unaccepted decision, an unsatisfied required check, a foreign profile request, an unsucceeded item, a foreign authority shipping, an interrupted copy duplicating or wedging, a traversal id escaping the store, a bit-flipped bundle crashing the consumer instead of refusing, a wrong-source or changed-source or tighter-bound request shipping, or bytes swapped after acceptance shipping.
